title: The Multitude at the Temple
summary: A multitude gathers around the temple in Bountiful, marveling at the great change and conversing about Jesus Christ.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: A great multitude of the people of Nephi gathered around the temple in the land Bountiful.
They marveled at the great change and conversed about Jesus Christ, concerning whom a sign had been given.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The gathered people converse in small groups around the temple.
unspecified_visual_details: The nature of the great change
The temple's architectural style
The people's clothing and individual appearances

narration.text: a great multitude gathered together
they were also conversing about this Jesus Christ

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the change itself; the verses do not specify what it was.

title: A Voice They Do Not Understand
summary: While the people converse, they hear a small voice as if from heaven, look around, and hear it again without understanding.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: The people heard a voice as if it came from heaven while conversing, but did not understand it; the voice was small rather than harsh or loud, and caused those who heard it to quake and their hearts to burn.
They heard the voice again and did not understand it.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People look around in response to the sound.
unspecified_visual_details: The visible source of the voice
Any visible representation of the effects described as piercing them or causing their hearts to burn

narration.text: they heard a voice as if it came out of heaven
again they heard the voice, and they understood it not

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The voice is reported as coming as if from heaven; do not depict a visible speaker.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show a divine figure or visible supernatural effects.

title: They Look Toward Heaven
summary: At the third hearing, the people open their ears, look steadfastly toward heaven, and understand the voice.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: The people heard the voice a third time, opened their ears to hear it, and looked steadfastly toward heaven from where the sound came.
The people understood the voice on the third hearing.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The multitude's attention is directed upward.
unspecified_visual_details: Any visible source of the voice

narration.text: the third time they did hear the voice
they did understand the voice which they heard

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The voice's words follow in the next scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show a visible divine speaker.

title: The Beloved Son
summary: The voice from heaven identifies the Beloved Son and tells the people to hear him.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: The voice declares the Beloved Son, in whom it is well pleased, and commands the people to hear him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The people listen while looking toward heaven.
unspecified_visual_details: The visible speaker and any visible heavenly form

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold my Beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased, in whom I have glorified my name—hear ye him.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Voice from heaven

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Father or another heavenly figure; no appearance is described.

title: A Man Descends
summary: The multitude looks up and sees a Man in a white robe descend from heaven and stand among them; they are silent and wonder what it means.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: The people saw a Man descend out of heaven, clothed in a white robe, and stand in their midst; the whole multitude looked at him and did not speak, thinking an angel had appeared.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The multitude's gaze is turned toward the descending Man.
unspecified_visual_details: The Man's facial features, age, and other appearance details

prohibited_inventions: Do not add distinctive physical features or visual effects not stated.

title: Jesus Christ Identifies Himself
summary: The Man stretches out his hand and tells the people that he is Jesus Christ, testified of by the prophets, and speaks of his mission and suffering.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: Jesus stretches forth his hand and speaks to the people.
He identifies himself as Jesus Christ, whom the prophets testified would come into the world.
He calls himself the light and life of the world and says he drank the bitter cup given by the Father, glorified the Father, and suffered the Father's will.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus speaks while the multitude listens.
unspecified_visual_details: Jesus's gesture beyond stretching forth his hand
Any visual depiction of the bitter cup, suffering, or sins

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold, I am Jesus Christ, whom the prophets testified shall come into the world.

I am the light and the life of the world

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Verse 11 is Jesus's teaching, not a narrated visible event.

title: The Multitude Falls
summary: After Jesus speaks, the multitude falls to the earth, remembering the prophecy that Christ would show himself after his ascension.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: After Jesus spoke, the multitude fell to the earth and remembered the prophecy that Christ would show himself after his ascension into heaven.

title: Come Forth and Know
summary: Jesus invites the people to come to him and feel the marks in his side, hands, and feet as witnesses of who he is.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: Jesus speaks to the people and invites them to arise and come forth to feel the marks in his side, hands, and feet, so they may know who he is and that he was slain for the sins of the world.

unspecified_visual_details: Whether Jesus displays his hands or side while speaking

prohibited_inventions: Do not add wounds, blood, or graphic detail.

title: One by One

explicit_facts.text: The multitude went forth one by one, touched Jesus's side and the prints in his hands and feet, saw and felt for themselves, and knew he was the one written of by the prophets.

title: Hosanna
summary: After all have witnessed, the multitude cries out together, falls at Jesus's feet, and worships him.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: After all had witnessed for themselves, the multitude cried out with one accord, fell at Jesus's feet, and worshipped him.

unspecified_visual_details: The arrangement and expressions of the multitude

spoken_dialogue.text: Hosanna! Blessed be the name of the Most High God!

title: Nephi Comes Forth
summary: Jesus calls Nephi, who comes forth, bows, kisses Jesus's feet, then rises and stands before him when commanded.
locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: Jesus spoke to Nephi, who was among the multitude, and commanded him to come forth.

title: Power to Baptize

locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: Jesus gives Nephi power to baptize the people after Jesus ascends into heaven.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus teaches that repentant people who desire baptism in his name are to be baptized by going down and standing in the water.

Jesus commands immersion in the water and coming forth again.

title: No Disputations

locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: Jesus teaches that the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost are one, and that he is in the Father and the Father in him.
Jesus says there should be no disputations concerning baptism or his doctrine.
Jesus teaches that the spirit of contention is not of him, but of the devil, and stirs people to contend with anger.

unspecified_visual_details: Any personified depiction of the devil or contention

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold, this is not my doctrine, to stir up the hearts of men with anger, one against another

title: Jesus Declares His Doctrine

locations: the temple in the land Bountiful

explicit_facts.text: Jesus teaches that believers in him believe in the Father, and that the Father and Holy Ghost bear record; the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost are one.
Jesus commands the people to repent, become as a little child, and be baptized in his name to receive these things and inherit God's kingdom.
